newsitem.title: USA: Tel-Save sees charges from AOL pact.
newsitem.headline: Tel-Save sees charges from AOL pact.

text.p: Tel-Save Holdings Inc said Thursday that its pact to deliver long distance telephone service to America Online Inc customers will result in charges of about $26 million, $25 million, and $12 million, respectively for the next three quarters.
The company said these items do not include non-cash charges related to the value of the performance warrants that are based on the number of subscribers.

So by the end of the first quarter of 1998, $77 million will have already been expensed, with the balance of the company's cash advance and warrants expensed over the remaining period until June 30, the company said. The company said it believes the benefits of this arrangement will continue over the long term with the expenses behind it.
